execution_scope: Shapely geometry metric probe only; does not execute Building Regulariser, CartAGen, IfcOpenShell, or any CAD/BIM exporter.
threshold_policy: No numeric acceptance thresholds frozen. Distances are meaningful only under the synthetic metre coordinate system; real thresholds must be calibrated to source scale, annotation uncertainty, drawing purpose, and reviewed design intent.

checks.question: Can a high per-object IoU hide a broken shared-boundary relation?
checks.meaning: Per-object overlap is insufficient; site-level relation checks are required.

checks.question: Can a high global IoU hide a two-object-to-one-object merge?
checks.meaning: Object identity/count is a hard invariant independent of overlap metrics.

checks.question: Does the validator expose a deleted courtyard hole?
checks.meaning: Hole count is a required topology invariant.

checks.question: Does a curved-intent adversarial candidate show large boundary/area deviation?
checks.meaning: Curved outlines need a preserve/review route; no production threshold is implied.

checks.question: Does the no-height-evidence fixture retain unknown height/floor states?
checks.meaning: Geometry processing must not fabricate massing evidence.

cases.name: hand-wobbled rectangle -> axis-aligned envelope candidate
cases.purpose: Check whether low area error alone masks boundary displacement.
cases.expected_validator_behavior: Report a candidate with a full diff; acceptance threshold requires calibration against human-marked intent.

cases.name: intentionally rotated rectangle -> forced global-axis envelope
cases.purpose: Detect destructive global-axis alignment of an intentional rotation.
cases.expected_validator_behavior: Do not auto-accept global-axis alignment; preserve trace and request intent evidence or review.

cases.name: U-shaped footprint -> bounding rectangle
cases.purpose: Ensure concavity loss is surfaced, not treated as harmless cleanup.
cases.expected_validator_behavior: Flag large concavity loss; require explicit approval before replacing a U/L/courtyard intent.

cases.name: courtyard footprint -> solid rectangle
cases.purpose: Ensure hole-count/topology checks catch courtyard deletion.
cases.expected_validator_behavior: Hard reject if a confirmed hole/courtyard disappears without an explicit design change.

cases.name: two attached buildings -> independent regularization gap
cases.purpose: Measure group-topology regression even when each footprint remains individually valid.
cases.expected_validator_behavior: Compare site-level adjacency graph and shared-boundary invariants; individual IoU is insufficient.

cases.name: two distinct near buildings -> merged candidate
cases.purpose: Ensure object identity/count is protected against geometry unions.
cases.expected_validator_behavior: Reject an unapproved identity merge; object count and IDs are hard invariants unless the designer explicitly merges them.

cases.name: curved annular segment -> minimum rotated rectangle
cases.purpose: Detect destructive loss of intentional curvature.
cases.expected_validator_behavior: Curvature/segment distribution outside the approved profile should trigger preserve or needs-review, not forced rectification.

cases.name: footprint without height evidence
cases.expected_validator_behavior: 2D footprint may pass; 3D body must remain absent or explicitly schematic/proposed and must not invent a confirmed height or floor count.
